$comment: Recipe for the video SFX + ambience library. Rationale and sources: docs/research/2026-09-07-video-sfx-and-ambience-library.md. Prompts follow the small-sfx recipe (TrackType: SFX, then source / action / production) and are written warm-and-dark on purpose: small-sfx is a post-trained checkpoint, so negative_prompt and cfg_scale do nothing and every constraint has to live in the positive prompt. Each sound is auditioned over `candidates` seeds (base seed + 0..n-1) and the best-scoring take is kept; the winning seed is recorded in the manifest, so the library stays exactly reproducible. Auditioning is not a luxury: at these short durations a large fraction of takes come back as broadband hiss, and which ones do is a property of the draw, not of the prompt or the duration. Prompts are phrased positively throughout: with no CFG on a post-trained checkpoint there is nothing to steer away from a negation, and naming an artefact in order to forbid it measurably made the click worse.

sounds.use: Default cut-masker. Land the cut ~60% through the whoosh.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a soft low-passed air whoosh, a heavy velvet curtain sweeping past the microphone in a dead room. Warm and muffled with the top end rolled off, more body than air, swelling in and falling away.

sounds.use: Bigger scene or chapter change; pair with impact_cinematic on the landing.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a deep cinematic whoosh built from filtered rushing air and a low sub sweep. It rushes past from left to right and settles into a short round low-end tail. Wide stereo, dark and smooth.

sounds.use: Swell into a hard cut; align the stop exactly on the cut frame.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a reverse whoosh that swells up out of silence into a clean cut-off point. Smooth rising air with a soft rounded top, stopping dead on the peak. Dry and close.

sounds.use: Quick wipes and fast-paced social edits where whoosh_soft is too long.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a very short fabric swish of a jacket sleeve moving quickly past the microphone. One quick pass with a fast decay. Close-mic'd in a dead room, soft and muffled.

sounds.use: Three-second build into a reveal or a statistic.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a short warm riser of filtered noise and a low hum rising steadily in pitch and volume over three seconds, stopping cleanly at the peak. Smooth and round throughout.

sounds.use: Restrained transition for factual pieces; sits under voiceover without pulling focus.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a slow band-passed noise sweep like wind moving through a narrow gap, drifting up and then away again. Restrained and neutral with a warm midrange.

sounds.use: Weight under a lower third or a card landing. The everyday impact.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a blunt soft thud made by dropping a heavy padded case onto a carpeted floor. It has a pronounced low-mid body that feels heavy, with a very fast damped decay. Close-mic'd in a small dead room.

sounds.use: Title cards and act breaks. Long tail: leave it room, do not cut it short.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a deep cinematic boom for a title card, a large soft mallet striking a huge low drum with a long round decaying tail in a wide dark hall. Weighty and clean at the bottom.

sounds.use: Section change or a hard stop. Check on speakers that can reproduce 40 Hz.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a massive sub-bass drop falling smoothly in pitch and fading out, like a tape machine being switched off. Pure round low end, smooth all the way down.

sounds.use: Documentary accent for a grave point. A restrained braam, not a trailer hit.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a low brass-like swell that grows and falls back, warm and muted, played softly in a large hall. Dark and restrained, a documentary accent rather than a trailer hit.

sounds.use: Drop over storm_bed_loop wherever you want a thunder roll. Kept separate on purpose: a thunder clap baked into a loop announces the repeat every cycle.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a long low roll of distant thunder, rumbling in from far away and fading slowly. Deep and soft-edged, heard across open country.

sounds.use: Something pops onto screen: an icon, a callout, a pin dropping on a map.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a soft round bubble pop, one water droplet released underwater and popping at the surface. Very short and gentle, centred in the low mids. Close-mic'd and dry.

sounds.use: Bullet points appearing one by one. Quieter sibling of pop_in.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a tiny wooden plop, a fingertip flicked off the rim of a small hollow wooden box. Extremely short with a soft rounded attack and a dry damped decay.

sounds.use: Cursor clicks in a screen recording or a product demo.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a soft muted click from a well-damped rubber keycap pressed once. A single quiet low-mid tap with an immediate damped decay. Close-mic'd in a dead room.

sounds.use: Step-by-step counters and timelines. Repeat it; do not use data_ticks for slow counts.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a light wooden tick, one small clock escapement step. Very quiet and soft with a short warm decay.

sounds.use: Turning to a new page, slide or chapter — the literal page-change cue.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a single sheet of soft paper turned over on a desk, one smooth slide and settle. Close-mic'd and quiet, gentle throughout.

sounds.use: A graph, panel or dashboard view sliding to the next state.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a smooth felt-lined drawer gliding open across a wooden desk and stopping. A soft sustained slide with a gentle settle at the end, close-mic'd and quiet.

sounds.use: A bar chart drawing in or a figure resolving. Time the last note to the final frame.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a short soft ascending shimmer of glass marimba notes rising quickly and ending on a held note that fades away. Gentle mallets, rounded and warm at the top.

sounds.use: Number count-ups and data streaming in. Fade under narration.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a rapid run of tiny soft data blips, quiet muted electronic ticks in an even stream that slows down and stops. Low level and warm.

sounds.use: A message or notification arriving on screen.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a gentle two-note notification chime on a soft mallet instrument, a low note followed by a slightly higher one, both warm and rounded with a short natural decay.

sounds.use: A step completing or a checkmark landing.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a warm three-note ascending phrase played on a wooden marimba with soft mallets. Evenly spaced and gently struck, each note decaying naturally in a small dry room.

sounds.use: Something did not work. Deliberately matter-of-fact, not a buzzer.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a gentle two-note descending cue on a muted low mallet instrument, soft and matter-of-fact. Warm and rounded with a short natural decay.

sounds.use: Typewriter text reveals. Retrigger per character at low level.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a single soft keystroke on a quiet membrane keyboard. Muted, low and immediate, damped as soon as it sounds.

sounds.use: Interface panels sliding in. Sub-second whoosh for motion graphics.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a short breathy air whoosh, a sheet of paper flicked quickly past the microphone. A light quick rush, smooth and dry, over in half a second.

sounds.use: General wet-weather bed. The safest rain: no thunder to clash with narration.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, steady light rain falling on soft ground and leaves, recorded from a sheltered doorway. Even and continuous throughout, warm and soft with a natural stereo field.

sounds.use: Interior scene with weather outside. Muffled, so dialogue sits over it easily.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, rain falling against a window pane heard from inside a quiet room, an even soft patter held at one steady intensity. Muffled by the glass, warm and cosy.

sounds.use: Heavy-weather bed. Continuous by design; add thunder_distant on top where you want it.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, heavy rain driving down outdoors with a low continuous wind roar underneath and a faint far-off rumble on the horizon. Dark, wide and unbroken.

sounds.use: Exteriors, landscapes, aerials. Gust swells are slow so they read as one movement.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, steady wind moving across open grassland, slow swelling gusts over a low continuous rush. Recorded with a windshield, smooth and warm end to end.

sounds.use: Nature documentary bed. Sparse birds, so the loop is long to hide repeats.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a calm daytime forest heard from a clearing, a soft continuous wash of wind through leaves with faint birdsong far away in the canopy. Distant, mellow and even.

sounds.use: Coastal establishing shots and calm reflective passages.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, small even wavelets running up a sandy shore in a steady rhythm, recorded a few metres back from the waterline. Soft continuous foam hiss, distant and warm, one wash blending into the next.

sounds.use: Woodland and countryside scenes; also a neutral water bed under maps.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a small stream running over stones in a quiet wood, a steady even burble held at one level. Close but soft, with a warm midrange.

sounds.use: Interior warmth, historical pieces, cosy segments.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a small wood fire burning in a hearth, a steady soft crackle over an underlying low roar. Warm and close, even throughout.

sounds.use: Patch silence between interview takes so cuts do not go dead. Keep it very low.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, the quiet interior room tone of an empty modern office at night, a low steady ventilation hum with faint air movement. Almost silent and completely even.

sounds.use: Urban interiors and skyline shots. No sirens or horns, so it never dates a shot.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, distant city traffic heard from a high window, a continuous low hum of cars blended together by distance. Soft, far away and even.

sounds.use: Conferences, museums, lobbies. Unintelligible on purpose — no words to lip-read against.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a distant indistinct crowd murmur in a large hall, a continuous even wash of low conversation blurred by the room. Soft and steady.

sounds.use: Night exteriors. The crickets are even, so the loop point is invisible.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a calm summer night across open countryside, an even wash of crickets heard from far away with a faint low movement of air. Soft, distant and continuous, the top end already rolled off by the distance.

sounds.use: Tension under a serious passage where music would be too much.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a low sustained cinematic drone, warm and dark, holding a steady bass tone with only the faintest slow movement inside it. Even in level from beginning to end.

sounds.use: Adds weight under any other bed. Felt more than heard; check on a full-range system.
sounds.prompt: TrackType: SFX, a very low sustained sub-bass bed, almost felt rather than heard, perfectly steady with slow gentle swells. Pure low end throughout.
